subject: problem running previously successful inla code. Problem with fields and pixmap packages and namespace file.

messages.author: d561f118e7e9fc17
messages.subject: problem running previously successful inla code. Problem with fields and pixmap packages and namespace file.
parts:
Hello,
I am trying to run some inla code that I previously ran successfully. However, when I went to update inla using inla.upgrade,  there was a problem with the namespace of the pixmap and fields packages. So I removed and redownloaded these packages. The problem continued. INLA would not run because of a conflict with these files.
 
. I then tried to load inla onto another computer. It loaded, but none of my code would run. I get an error: "failed to execute inla.exe".
 
I think that maybe there is some conflict with inla and some of the packages it uses, which have been changed. THey have been updated for the new R version 2.14. Please let me know if anyone else is having problems.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: problem running previously successful inla code. Problem with fields and pixmap packages and namespace file.
parts: We're currently working on fixing the "namespace" issues with R 2.14.  But "failed to execute inla.exe" sounds like a different problem.  What is the output of R.Version() and inla.version() on that other computer?

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: problem running previously successful inla code. Problem with fields and pixmap packages and namespace file.
parts: The "failed to execute" issue has apparently happend to others as well.  Can you try adding the option "verbose=TRUE" to your inla call and see if that makes a difference?

messages.subject: Re: problem running previously successful inla code. Problem with fields and pixmap packages and namespace file.

But a few months ago it would work with update=TRUE. Now neither works.

messages.author: d561f118e7e9fc17
messages.subject: Re: problem running previously successful inla code. Problem with fields and pixmap packages and namespace file.
parts: I was able to get INLA to run on a computer with windows 7. My computer still has XP operating system. For some reason, I think INLA no longer will run on XP operating system. Most people probably have upgraded to windows 7, so wouldn't have this problem.
